title: Avocado Cream in Winter: A Simple Winter Face Cream Guide for India

keyword: avocado cream in winter / winter face cream India
quick: Yes, avocado cream suits winter well. Its rich oils help dry, tight skin feel soft and comfortable. Apply a pea-sized amount on slightly damp skin at night, add a thin layer in the morning if needed, and always finish the morning with sunscreen.
facts: Cold, dry air and room heaters pull moisture from the skin.
Apply cream on slightly damp skin to hold water in.
Use more in north Indian winters, less on the humid coast.
Wear sunscreen daily, especially with kojic acid creams.
